propositions: When completion verifier FAILs due to evidence search exhaustion (budget spent without criterion refutation), the gate currently reports failure to the operator instead of automatically resuming verification

A resumption loop should wrap the verify_completion invocation at the shared close-gate seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck:638) to re-run the whole verifier with the same arguments, allowing the verdict cache to seed credited PASSes and concentrate the fresh budget on remaining criteria

Auto-resume must qualify using the existing _insufficiency_only predicate to distinguish genuine criterion refutations (which require operator ruling) from insufficiency-only states (which are the gate's responsibility to resolve)

Resumption attempts are bounded by verify.auto_resume_max (default 2, 0 disables) and by a progress condition: only dispatch if the prior attempt's cache-credited PASS count strictly exceeds the previous attempt's count, stopping early on zero-progress to avoid infinite spin
Resumption trail (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining count) must be recorded and visible on the ticket or close output for operator visibility into the auto-resume behavior
The resumption loop implementation must sit at the shared transition seam so that CLI, MCP, and library close paths all exercise it, and no schema/prompt/model-facing changes are introduced
